summary: Wave 10 fix (find-fec66ce8) reviewed: completeness confirmed (grep of all 9 files shows zero remaining raw fetch() calls, including helper methods); the 3 standalone wrappers (YouTube/Deezer/ACRCloud) correctly hold CircuitBreaker as a per-instance field and call resilientFetch with the same DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS default as IntegrationBaseService.fetch -- no behavior drift; the 6 base-class conversions have no .then()/callback usage anywhere in these files, so no this-scoping risk. Circuit-breaker isolation is per-instance (matches pre-existing IntegrationBaseService pattern, not a new regression). However instagram.service.spec.ts's changed assertion (expect.objectContaining({method:'DELETE'})) does not actually exercise/prove the fix: since the test mocks global.fetch directly and objectContaining ignores the added signal field, this assertion passes identically whether this.fetch is used (fixed) or raw fetch is used (reverted). This is a false-green test per the false-green-prevention rule and fails requirement 4 of the review objective (test fidelity). Filed as find-dd523831.
